description: Seat prestarted M3 sensor and M4 extrusion fasteners with preset torque drivers at a sensor service bench.
count_scope: Eight work orders; seeds do not multiply the count. A selection of one of the first six tasks without a contract keeps its original instruction, id and evaluator. The task set selects contract tighten-tasks-v1 explicitly for sensor, aim, frame, support and access. mixed keeps its own evaluator (tighten-mixed-v1). front-m4 and find-loose use tighten-tasks-v1. find-loose seeds choose one of three loose screws deterministically.

evaluator.scope: Each required screw: its preset driver's clutch released while the bit was in that socket, then at least 80% of the equation load at that release torque retained for 0.25 s after the bit left, with helical advance; M3 solved bit moment (2.1 ms average) at or below SICK's 0.4 N m; geometric photoelectric ray; task-specific rail position. mixed differs: own-preset-driver clicks voided by 10 hands-off readings below the floor or by back-rotation past the click angle, 2.1 ms hands-off retention, rail level (slot position and yaw count only through detection), the reference flag at its home and detected there with most of the spot on it, nothing robot-held touching the assembly, and 0.95 x per-screw partial credit unless successful, with the flag return graded and the aim judged at the flag's home (TightenEnv.MIXED_SCOPE). Privileged metrics remain outside policy observations. Eight-task contract tighten-tasks-v1: hands-off retention and own-driver clicks as mixed; task-specific rail, home flag and prior-clamp preservation. Score 1 on success else 0.95 x continuous load progress above the settled start with geometry and collateral-load grades; no bonus for untouched preload. Every evaluation reports task_contract.

qualification: Defined task catalogue. It does not imply that every variation passed physical qualification. The seven tasks other than mixed have not been run with the simulator: their construction presets, renders and 10 s hands-off rest are not checked, and robot bit insertion is not demonstrated.

task_set.qualification: Checked by stubbed tests only; not yet run with the simulator or rendered.
